description: CSS gradients on both renderers: linear (two stops, an angle, several stops, hard stops, transparency over another layer, repeating), radial (circle, ellipse, hard stop, repeating) and conic (smooth, hard stops) gradients, several background layers, a gradient under a border and rounded corners, and a background-position transition sampled mid-way; every cell is a pixel region. The GPU renderer drew gradients half a pixel off before the vello fork sampled them at pixel centres; what Blitz draws differently is in blitz-gradients
